status: PLAN — the calls are authorised only by D-270's status token and the authorisation file's unspent entries; this file never authorises by itself
question: Do new, compact, clearly different illustrations — placed by D-269's unchanged rule in D-269's chest-center box on the unchanged D-264 master — give a recognisable main form at 110x165, a distinct graphic mark at 52x78, and Northstar's drawn quality in close-up, on a fixed set of shirt colours?
advisory: ChatGPT's assessment (advisory, recorded as given): the chest-center placement is promising at 110x165. No item is approved by the owner.
deliveries: three separate transparent images, one motif per call; never one sheet with several motifs (no segmentation after receipt)

sizeRule.statement: the motif's visible content (the alpha >= 8 box, never the transparent canvas) is cropped and scaled as large as the box allows (contain, aspect kept, nothing cut), capped at inkShare of the box's area in ink; premultiplied area resample; one constant for every motif (D-269, unchanged)

lock.noChangeAfterReceipt: the master, its mapping, the box, the size rule, the checks and their thresholds are not changed after receipt; the evaluation refuses a module or fingerprint that differs; no motif is retouched, re-centred, recoloured or masked

colours.cream: the cut's own fabric (median of top-tee-hip-cream on C)

visual: 110x165: the motif's main form is recognised (what it is: the animal, the object, the emblem) — the face and small details are not required
52x78: the motif reads as a small graphic mark (a distinct shape and colour on the shirt), not as a smudge
close-up (2x): Northstar's drawn quality — even bold outline, flat cel colours, clean edges, no colour rim, no halo, no shadow
the motif itself: one compact shape, a strong silhouette, few large colour fields; no text, no small face details, no loose stars or broad decoration
each shirt colour: the silhouette and the main colour fields hold against the shirt; the contrast class is advisory and never a pass
placement: balanced on the chest under the neck rib, nothing cut, clear of the seams and armpits (D-269's box, unchanged)

classes.deliveryRejected: a delivery check failed or a format reject at receipt; the motif is still kept, rendered and shown
classes.requiresVisualReview: every delivered motif that passes the delivery checks; never an automatic pass
classes.usable: only after the owner's visual review

accept.contrastClasses: clear / borderline / weak per motif and shirt colour; advisory, never a pass mark: clear still needs the visual review, borderline goes to it explicitly, weak is reported as a poor combination and kept

reporting: the yield of the generation (delivered, delivery checks passed) and the quality of the chosen combinations (visual, per motif and colour) are reported apart; every result is kept, rejected motifs and poor colour combinations too
knownLimits: D-264/D-269: the master's displacement gives large prints slightly wavy outlines and nearest-sample steps; the chest is drawn flat, so a print does not follow folds
D-269: a small light speck at the neck rib on the plain shirt (not from the prints)
D-269: the chest-center box is wider than tall (150 x 135 px on C); a motif's format decides how much of the box it gets
the contrast check measures colour separation from the shirt; it does not judge legibility, appeal or style
evaluation: node tools/avatar/northstar-tee-print-validation.mjs --from-calls --out <dir outside the repo>: the lock, the delivery checks, the motif placed by D-269's rule on every shirt colour, the contrast class, sheets (raw, torso, close-up 2x, 110x165 and 52x78 actual and 3x), a private preview and the record (never rewritten)

calls.purpose: one compact animal motif as a large central chest print (D-269's chest-center box and size rule, unchanged)

motif.what: a fox sitting in side profile with its big bushy tail curled around its feet. A warm orange body, a cream chest and tail tip, dark brown legs and ear tips. The face is reduced to one small solid dark eye: no mouth, no eyebrows, no whiskers.
motif.why: a living creature with a silhouette that is recognised by its outline alone (pointed ears, the curled bushy tail); the face is reduced to one eye so it does not depend on small details; orange is close to coral and mustard, so the contrast check meets a real borderline case

prompt.text: Create one standalone graphic for a large chest print on the T-shirt of a children's cartoon game avatar, on a fully transparent background: a fox sitting in side profile with its big bushy tail curled around its feet. A warm orange body, a cream chest and tail tip, dark brown legs and ear tips. The face is reduced to one small solid dark eye: no mouth, no eyebrows, no whiskers. Flat print-ready artwork in a clean cel-shaded cartoon style: one bold dark navy outline of even weight around the whole silhouette, thinner navy lines between the colour areas, and a few large flat colour areas, each solid with at most one hard-edged darker tone; no gradients, no texture, no small details. One single compact shape with a strong, instantly recognisable silhouette, centred and upright, about as wide as it is tall, filling about 80 percent of the image; an empty transparent margin on every side, nothing touches the image edges. No text, letters or numbers. No separate decorations around it: no stars, sparkles, dots, lines, speed lines or other shapes. No T-shirt, no fabric, no mockup, no background colour, no white sticker border, no drop shadow, no glow, no frame.
